title: Una noche en la biblioteca
instructions: Completa cada espacio con el pretérito o el imperfecto del verbo entre paréntesis.

questions.text: ___ (ser) las ocho y la plaza ___ (estar) casi vacía.
explanations: Imperfect: telling the time sets the scene.
Imperfect: the nearly empty square is background description.

questions.text: Todos los viernes, Lucía ___ (ir) a la biblioteca después del trabajo.
explanations: Imperfect: going to the library was her regular Friday habit.

questions.text: Aquella noche, Lucía ___ (caminar) hacia la entrada cuando ___ (oír) un golpe.
explanations: Imperfect: she was already walking when the noise interrupted her.
Preterite: hearing the bang is the event that interrupts her walk.

questions.text: Junto a la puerta, un hombre ___ (buscar) algo debajo de un banco.
explanations: Imperfect: his search was already in progress when she noticed him.

questions.text: Lucía ___ (acercarse) para ayudarlo, pero él ___ (ponerse) rojo de vergüenza.
explanations: Preterite: approaching him is a completed action that moves the story forward.
Preterite: turning red marks the onset of his embarrassment.

questions.text: El hombre le ___ (decir) que ___ (creer) que había perdido las llaves de la biblioteca.
explanations: Preterite: he tells her what happened in a single completed exchange.
Imperfect: his belief is an ongoing mental state at that moment.

questions.text: Lucía las ___ (encontrar) debajo del banco y se las dio.
explanations: Preterite: finding the keys is the completed event that resolves the problem.

questions.text: De camino a casa, Lucía ___ (pensar) en aquel encuentro.
questions.note: Pensó (preterite) would also work if her thinking during the walk is viewed as a complete episode.
explanations: Imperfect: her thoughts are presented as ongoing during the walk home.
